meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides "use the app" pop-ups, Reels, Explore tab, Stories and Highlights, suggested posts, posts, verified badges, footer links
meta.notes: LIVE (logged out, iPhone UA, 390x844): app-overlay matched 1 element (the fixed overlay holding the dialog, backdrop and close button; hiding the dialog alone leaves the dimmed backdrop), open-app-pill matched 1 (unscoped a[href*=applink.instagram.com] matches 18, every grid tile), the Reels and Explore tab wrappers matched 1 each. The overlay rule needs a login link on the page, so a logged-in share sheet (also role=dialog) is never hidden. Not seen live (logged-in only, from community lists: viki53 Instagram Purified 2025-07, shraiwi Nuke Insta Slop 2026-09, Instagram Unhook): reels-video-posts, stories-tray, suggested-*, posts, wrapped tab layout. reels-profile-tab: the SVG label was seen live, the wrapper structure was not. reels-video-posts also hides ordinary video posts. posts also hides a post opened by address. Class names rotate; never use them. DESKTOP (macOS Safari UA, logged out, live in the app, 2026-11-10): the login page is all a logged-out visitor gets on /; public profiles such as /nasa/ render. Matched there: profile-highlights, verified-ticks, page-footer. The feed rules were written for the same React app and keep matching by structure, but the signed-in feed could not be reached, so the Reels, Explore, Stories and posts rules were not re-checked on desktop. Messages stays visible on purpose (the fixtures mark it data-keep).
